findings.title: Plugin request logs lose traceID field
findings.body: The previous logRequest implementation explicitly appended traceID from tracing.TraceIDFromContext to the plugin request log fields. This change removes that code and the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware only injects endpoint, pluginId, datasource, and user attributes. Unless another middleware outside this diff injects traceID into the log context, Plugin Request Completed logs emitted by LoggerMiddleware will no longer contain traceID, reducing trace/log correlation.

findings.title: NewMetricsMiddleware mutates a shared middleware instance when wrapping next client
findings.body: NewMetricsMiddleware creates a single *MetricsMiddleware and returns a ClientMiddlewareFunc that sets imw.next = next each time it is applied. If the middleware is applied more than once or to multiple client chains, all chains share the same MetricsMiddleware and overwrite each other's next client, causing requests to be dispatched to the wrong downstream client. Concurrent application can also race on the next field. Returning a new MetricsMiddleware per next, while sharing the registered metric collectors, would avoid this.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to Logger interface is a breaking API change
findings.body: The exported log.Logger interface now requires FromContext(context.Context) Logger. Any external implementation of this interface will fail to compile until updated. The PR updates in-repo implementations, but this is still an API/contract break for consumers of pkg/plugins/log.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a logger that does not record into the original fake
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns NewTestLogger(), discarding the receiver's recorded log state. Code under test that calls logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...) will emit logs to a new fake that the test cannot inspect, so assertions on the original TestLogger will miss those messages. This makes the fake unsuitable for verifying LoggerMiddleware's FromContext-based logging.

findings.title: No tests for the new contextual logger middleware
findings.body: The PR moves request-scoped log attributes from the metrics/instrumentation middleware into a new ContextualLoggerMiddleware and changes LoggerMiddleware to rely on FromContext, but only renames the existing metrics middleware test. There is no automated test that ContextualLoggerMiddleware adds the expected attributes or that LoggerMiddleware logs them, so regressions in context propagation or log fields can go unnoticed.
